name: Task KPI Report
query:
SELECT 'Total Tasks' AS kpi, COUNT(name) AS value
FROM `tabTask`

UNION ALL
SELECT 'Completed Tasks' AS kpi, COUNT(name) AS value
FROM `tabTask`
WHERE status = 'Completed'

UNION ALL
SELECT 'Open Tasks' AS kpi, COUNT(name) AS value
FROM `tabTask`
WHERE status != 'Completed'

UNION ALL
SELECT 'Overdue Tasks' AS kpi, COUNT(name) AS value
FROM `tabTask`
WHERE status != 'Completed'
  AND exp_end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND exp_end_date < CURDATE();
